color.summary: Radix Colors' 12-step scales: slate for the neutrals, indigo for the accent. The page is white (#111113 in dark), text slate-12 #1c2024 (#edeef0) and muted text #60646c. The accent solid, indigo-9 #3e63dd, is the same in both modes; links and soft text use indigo-11 (#3a5bc7, #9eb1ff in dark) and soft fills indigo-3 (#edf2fe). Edges are alpha steps: slate-a7 around fields (#cdced6 on white) and slate-a6 for separators (#d9d9e0). Menus and dialogs sit on the solid panel: white, or slate-2 #18191b in dark.
usage: Every color prop swaps the whole scale: a red menu item, a green soft field and an orange soft badge use steps 3, 9 and 11 of their own hue.

type.summary: The components default to the system stack (-apple-system): 14/20 at size 2, 12/16 at size 1 and 16/24 at size 3, with 500 on buttons, badges and the active tab. The docs site sets Untitled Sans on its own chrome and Söhne Mono for code. Headings are 500 with tight tracking, such as 24/30 at -0.3px.

shape.summary: radius="medium" by default: buttons, fields, selects and menu rows have 3px corners at size 1, 4px at size 2 and 6px at size 3. Cards have 8px, dialogs 12px. Switches and progress bars are pills. The radius prop (none to full) scales every corner together.

spacing.summary: Three control sizes: 24px (size 1), 32px with 12px sides (size 2, the default) and 40px (size 3). Tabs are 40px, menu rows 32px with 12px sides. Dialogs pad 24px and cards 12px. The scaling prop resizes everything from 90% to 110%.

elevation.summary: Edges are inset shadows, not borders: a 1px slate-a7 ring on fields and the surface and outline variants. Menus, selects and dialogs share one stack: a 1px ring plus 0 12px 60px at 15% and a tighter 12px drop. The classic variants add a small raised shadow and a soft gradient. The dialog scrim is black at 40% (60% in dark). Focus is a 2px indigo-8 ring, #8da4ef (#435db1 in dark).

button.summary: Six variants of one button, each in any color: solid, soft, surface, outline, classic and ghost, at sizes 1 to 4. The default is solid indigo at size 2. The docs' own controls (prop info, copy) are ghost buttons.

provenance.notes: Written block by block from the census (spec.json, census 154a8a6) and its page shots: the Radix Themes component docs pages, light and dark, at the docs' theme (indigo accent, slate gray, medium radius). Token values are from @radix-ui/themes 3.3.0 and @radix-ui/colors 3.0.0, read in the pack. Names without a from are Radix's variant and size props; names marked docs are prop values from the docs; names marked ai are ours.
